title: Deluxe Melody Boys and the Corley brothers
summary: Albert doesn't know the Deluxe Melody Boys but knows the Corley Brothers, Austin musicians who attended Sam Houston College.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever hear of the Deluxe Melody Boys?
Yeah, Deluxe. Right. Where were they from?
I don't remember offhand. You look these things up and then you forget where you got your questions from.
Right, right. I don't know where the Deluxe Band was.
Did you know the Corleys, George Corley and Reginald Corley?

Sure, Corley Brothers. Who were they? Musicians. Well, one of these musicians we have here, the Corley Brothers were from Austin. That's their home. And they attended Sam Houston College, which is gone now. It's a combined college now with Deluxe. But that's where these brothers went. Yeah, well, were they, did they have a band there on? Yes, they did around there. Local band. Didn't travel too much. What about Eddie and Sugarloo?
